confirmed_source_findings.finding: QNN/QNC/QNR are UDM scalar package members labelled #kg(-1), advanced by common scalar tendencies and RK mass-coordinate update.
For zero assembled tendency, W_new*q_new=W_old*q_old, W=C1H*(MU+MUB)+C2H. MU/MUB labels are dry air mass in column in Pa. This is exact update algebra, not a parcel compression simulation.

With vapor cap, bounds and floors inactive, cloud water increment is embryo_mass*ncact*dt/DEN and raw cloud number increment ncact*dt. Interpreting ncact as #m^-3 s^-1 gives dimensional closure. Internal ncmin/ncmax are explicitly commented m^-3. This does not establish external field units.

QNC/QNN/QNR copied directly into/out of ncr; default CCN ccn_conc #m^-3 assigned directly to QNN if incoming max<1. Current driver ccn_preinitialized=true suppresses first-step UDM reset. This concrete default CCN path is not every QNC incoming or restart provenance.

Slope/radius uses raw nc/(qc*DEN), dimensionally volume-style number under stated mass-volume interpretation. Small-number eligibility uses nc*DEN, a distinct density-weighted guard; do not infer all branches have one uniform number convention.

dend=(p/T-DEN*Rv)/(Rd-Rv) is labeled dry density; rain number is multiplied by dend before semi-Lagrangian fallout and divided by dend afterward. This is another mass-specific-style arithmetic path; it concerns rain ncr3, not direct evidence that cloud Nc must be globally rescaled.
make_DropletNumber plus density division is gated on Thompson/ThompsonAero/RCON; it does not normalize arbitrary UDM QNC by evidence of this code path.

interpretation_qualifications.compression: A conserved material parcel number per selected air mass implies N_volume scales with that basis density under physical compression, but no parcel compression was executed or established by a zero-flux RK-cell test.
interpretation_qualifications.correction: No globally safe density multiplier, Registry relabel, activation correction, or producer/consumer normalization is recommended from this audit alone. Coupled transport, bounds, source/sink and sedimentation conventions must be resolved consistently.
interpretation_qualifications.dry_vs_moist_density: WRF physics prep rho=1/alt*(1+qv) (module_big_step_utilities_em.F:4856) distinguishes total moist-air density from dry-air coordinate weighting. For a hypothetical dry-mass-specific number, N_volume=rho_dry*q; N_volume=rho_air*q presumes matching air-mass definition. The report air-mass wording must remain conditional.
interpretation_qualifications.future_conditional_RTE: Held-state radius alternatives or six-call flux changes are conditional optical sensitivities, not a physical compression model or evidence choosing the true Nc units.
interpretation_qualifications.input_provenance: Registry text, initializer and internal equations establish inherited dimensional tension, not actual units of every imported, restart, boundary, or positive retained QNC.
interpretation_qualifications.pressure_coordinate: W is a dry-pressure-coordinate weight (Pa), not local physical volume or full layer mass in kg; vertical thickness/Jacobian/gravity and horizontal parcel motion are not supplied by the algebra alone. Zero tendency with changed W changes q inversely, rather than proving q stays fixed under all density changes.

report_precision_caveats: Exact pressure-coordinate storage invariant is supported; statements of local physical compression and rho_air-based volume conversion need the preceding qualifications.
